title: Learning to Incentivise: Using Reinforcement Learning for Sustainable Urban Mobility
abstract: arXiv:2610.30469v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Traffic management has traditionally focused on toll-based and road pricing solutions. However, road pricing often raises concerns about accessibility and public dissatisfaction, leading to its prohibition in some places, such as Finland. This study optimises the dynamic allocation of incentives to drivers, encouraging them to reroute onto alternative (potentially longer) paths to achieve greater societal benefit, reduced total travel time (TTT) and total emissions in the transportation network, contributing to sustainable urban mobility. We employ a multi-agent reinforcement learning approach to dynamically assign incentives to drivers to reduce both TTT and emissions, with travel times estimated using traffic simulation software. translated_title: 学会激励：利用强化学习实现可持续城市出行
translated_abstract: 交通管理传统上一直专注于基于收费和道路定价的解决方案。然而，道路收费常常引发关于可及性和公众不满的担忧，导致其在某些地区（如芬兰）被禁止。本研究优化了对驾驶员的动态激励分配，鼓励他们改道至替代（可能更长的）路径，以实现更大的社会效益，即降低交通网络中的总出行时间（TTT）和总排放量，为可持续城市出行做出贡献。我们采用多智能体强化学习方法，动态地为驾驶员分配激励，以同时降低总出行时间和排放量，其中出行时间通过交通仿真软件进行估算。我们证明，在预算不受限制且以最小化出行时间为目标的情况下，该激励方案相比预算相当的动态用户均衡（UE）方案可将总出行时间降低16%……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种多智能体强化学习方法，通过动态向驾驶员发放激励引导其改道，在可持续城市出行框架下同时将交通网络的总出行时间降低16%并减少总排放量。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a multi-agent reinforcement learning approach that dynamically allocates incentives to drivers to encourage rerouting, reducing total travel time by 16% and cutting emissions in urban traffic networks for sustainable urban mobility.
